player_prompt.intro:
Nyewe nye Aɖaŋu {player_id} si le dame Checkers me abe {color}.
Wɔ dɔ damea ƒe ŋkɔwo ƒe ŋkɔwo ƒe ŋkɔwo abe '[fileRank fileRank]', habɔbɔ '[b2c3]' (kpɔɖeŋu a–h, ɣleti 0–7).
Damea ƒe ŋkɔwo:
  • Dɔ damea ƒe kɔkɔe le eƒe ŋu 1 eye wòazu.
  • Xɔe ƒe ŋkɔwo le eƒe dzi eye wòazu.
  • Aɖaŋu si wɔ dɔ kɔkɔe eye wòazu la, wòakpɔ ŋkɔwo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Enya nududu format bɔla ɖo. Ŋutsɔ [a1b2], e.g. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Keklẽtɔa megale eƒe akpa aɖeke si o. Akɔ dzɔa dzi!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Kpe siwo susɔ la vɔ le ameyibɔwo si. Amedzĩwo ɖu dzi!
outcome.no_moves: Fefewɔla {player_id} mekpɔ kpɔ be yeazã eƒe ŋusẽ o.
outcome.draw: Míeto míaƒe mɔa ƒe akpa si le eƒe goawo dzi.
